rachel (docs): The API ref for POST /v1/credentials/create shows the response including `api_key` in plaintext in the example body. Security flagged this since our service now returns only a masked key in the body and the full key in a one-time header `X-API-Key-Secret` instead. Can we reconcile?

sam (eng-auth): We changed behavior: for security we do not include the full key in JSON responses to reduce accidental leaks in logs. Instead we set header `X-API-Key-Secret: sk_live_...` on creation and return `api_key_masked` in body. Docs must reflect that.

rachel (docs): current example: ```json
{ "id": "cred_123", "api_key": "sk_live_abcdef" }
```
should be replaced with: ```http
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
X-API-Key-Secret: sk_live_abcdef
Content-Type: application/json

{ "id": "cred_123", "api_key_masked": "sk_live_*****ef" }
```
Also add note: full key shown only in header once; clients should store it immediately and not log it.

li (sdk): SDKs currently read body.api_key. I'll update helpers to check headers first and fall back to body.api_key_masked for display. I'll add a short snippet in docs showing Node + Python secure storage example.

maria (support): We had a customer open a ticket because they followed the old example and couldn't find the key in the body. Please add troubleshooting note: check response headers or use SDK helper.

rachel (docs): Proposed doc changes: 1) Replace body example with masked key and include header in the HTTP response sample. 2) Add "one-time secret" callout advising immediate storage and not to echo the key. 3) Add SDK snippet mapping header -> local secure store. 4) Add troubleshooting note for missing key.

sam (eng-auth): Approved. We'll also add an audit log entry when a secret is returned for compliance.

li (sdk): PR opened, linked to docs PR. Example mapping: ```js
const secret = res.headers.get('X-API-Key-Secret');
if (secret) secureStore.save('apiKey', secret);
else console.warn('api key only masked in body; check admin portal');
```
